description.default: Renders Nonna's back-office desk for the Copilot Pizza Factory trattoria on the Copilot canvas: the shift rota (who works which slot, open seats highlighted), purchase orders waiting for a signature (with grams, cost and supplier), and the supplier invoice ledger with a running total — starting as a compact inline card and expanding to the full desk. Invoke for any question about shifts, sick calls and cover, approvals and procurement, or supplier spending.
